projects.description: An AI recruiting platform currently being developed at Elite Innovative Solutions. I designed the UI in Figma and built the frontend in React, translating recruiter workflows into intuitive interfaces, dashboards, and AI-powered recruiting features.

Collaborated with a team of 3 developers to create an intuitive website which showcases trending but sustainable clothing. Scraped multiple clothing and recommerce stores, while integrating API's. Overall, this web app aims to help you protect the environment while ensuring you don't break the bank.

Designed a user-friendly website to allow easy access to movie descriptions and streaming options. Incorporated TMDB's API, as well as created a backend API using MongoDB, allowing users to write movie reviews.

Created a Flask website for book lovers to get personalized book recommendations. Utilized an item-based collaborative filtering approach, a method used by Netflix, to give users recommendations based on previous books they read.

My portfolio is what you are looking at right now. I designed it to showcase all my web dev projects in an organized manner. Integrated PHPMailer to create a functional contact form and implemented responsive design for all screens.

graphic_design_projects.description: A playful soda brand built around bold, energetic visuals that reflect its fruity, fizzy personality. The identity uses funky typography and expressive design elements to capture a fun consumer experience.

A minimalist skincare brand inspired by water and purity, using clean, refined visuals to express natural beauty and understated luxury. The identity is built around calm, minimal visuals and a soft, water-inspired color palette.
An irresistible baked goods brand centered around a rebellious “forbidden treat” concept. Bold, attention-grabbing visuals make the product feel indulgent and unforgettable.
